plan.notes: Official 'Suggested Course Sequence' from Cabrillo College (Biology AS-T  - Transfer Pathway to CSUMB). Cabrillo labels this 'a suggested sequence of coursework' and notes 'This is not an official educational plan'; sequenced here as the college's published pathway. Credit ranges use the source lower bound: CAL-GETC AREA 4 SOCIAL AND BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES: 3-4, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 3B HUMANITIES: 3-5, lower bound used; PHYS 2A / PHYS 4A: 4-5, lower bound used; PHYS 2B / PHYS 4B: 4-5, lower bound used; CAL-GETC AREA 4 SOCIAL AND BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES: 3-4, lower bound used.
